svg.text: Rabbit 2.0 signal wiring: Raspberry Pi 4 header and every device connector

Net names match on both ends. GPIO numbers are BCM. All logic is 3.3 V. Pins with a boot default pull-down (GPIO9-27) carry the fail-safe outputs, so a booting or dead Pi means: E-stop on, Jetson on, switch on.
<- pin 36 GPIO16 ESTOP_RUN; 1 kOhm S3 -> GND at this header
Config: packet serial 115200, address 0x80; S3 = E-Stop (non-latching);
M1/M2 max current 3 A, write to NVM; serial timeout 0.5 s (set by the node);
duty capped on the host at 12 V / battery V (0.71 at 16.8 V).
<- pin 14 GND (shared with the S-header GND run)
-> pin 18 GPIO24 INA_ALERT (open drain, Pi pull-up on)
A1 = GND, A0 = VS -> address 0x41 (as today)
<- Kelvin pair from the 2 mOhm battery shunt
6 V current through on-board 10 mOhm (R pad)
<- Kelvin pair from the 5 mOhm motor shunt
12 V current through on-board 10 mOhm (R pad)
Shunt pads take 2512 resistors (R12, R1, R13, R9: check which is which on
the silkscreen). Terminals J1/J5 carry 10 A at most.
RPLIDAR C1 (5-pin cable from the kit)
<- 5 V rail (D24V90F5), 0.8 A at start / star
460800 baud, 3.3 V TTL; needs a start command (rabbit-lidar).
4x VL53L8CX on Pololu #3419, one I2C bus each
<- ToF 3.3 V regulator (not 5 V: I/O follows VIN)
All at 0x29. Twisted SDA+GND and SCL+GND, <= 40 cm.
ToF 3.3 V regulator EN <- Q2 drain (GPIO18 high = all ToF off, power-cycle).
COM -> GND, NC in series -> pin 38 GPIO20
COM -> GND, NC in series -> pin 40 GPIO21
4.7 kOhm to 3V3 + 100 nF to GND at the Pi
Rest = LOW. Pressed or broken wire = HIGH = stop.
pin 37 GPIO26 <-> GND; 10 kOhm to 3V3, 100 nF
<- 5 V (series R if not built in) / Q3 drain
Pololu Big Pushbutton Power Switch HP #2813
gate <- pin 22 GPIO25 via 1k, 100k gate-GND; drain -> D36V50F12 EN
gate <- pin 12 GPIO18 via 1k, 100k; drain -> ToF regulator EN
gate <- pin 13 GPIO27 via 1k, 100k; drain -> LED cathode
Regulator EN has a 100 kOhm pull-up to VIN, so the default is ON; GPIO high turns it off.
Never drive EN straight from a GPIO: the pull-up to 16.8 V would feed the Pi pin.
<- 12 V from INA ch4 IN-, 5.5/2.5 mm, centre +
not fitted on the dev kit: optional SMD mod, CR1225
-> Raspberry Pi Flash Drive 256 GB (boot, Forge, JetStream)
-> USB 3 hub upstream (Wi-Fi adapter, RoboClaw USB)
<- Camera Module 3 Wide, 15-pin 1 mm FFC 300 mm
not used: never together with the 5 V pin feed
